name: Sherrie Hirshblad Vertran
source:
Oliver's mother. She seems to be confused lately.

[spoiler]After her husband Roger disappears and their family losing their wealth, she sells Oliver to Kristian Orvood. Kristian kills her over the disagreement about the contract.[/spoiler]
